description: This header file defines the WebPA Abstraction APIs for libparodus, including functions for setting notification configuration, managing libparodus connection, stopping the receive thread, and sending notifications.

methods.name: libpd_set_notifyConfigFile
methods.description: Sets the initial notify configuration files.

methods.name: libpd_client_mgr
methods.description: Initializes libparodus connection and loads the database.

methods.name: stop_parodus_recv_wait
methods.description: Stops the parodus receive wait thread.

methods.name: sendNotification
methods.description: Sends a notification message with specified payload, source, and destination.
